facts: Parties: Oakhurst Holdings Ltd (Buyer), Dunmore Technologies Ltd (Seller); the Company is Juniper Medical Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 7 September 2026; Closing is scheduled for 9 December 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 150 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 7 September 2026), either party may terminate.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 12 months after termination of employment.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 21 March 2027.
